verdict.rationale: The only on-topic evidence is a single line in Xero's official MCP server README listing "Chart of Accounts management" as a capability. That confirms some first-party ability to manage the chart of accounts, but nothing describes customizing account types, creating sub-accounts, or applying class/tag dimensions. missing for 10: documentation of account-type configuration, sub-account hierarchy, class/tag (tracking category) dimensions, an accountant-facing UI workflow for COA customization, independent or hands-on corroboration

support.subject: As an accountant, I can customize the chart of accounts with account types, sub-accounts, and class or tag dimensions
